newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs to watch 10-year JGB auction result.
newsitem.headline: JGBs to watch 10-year JGB auction result.

text.p: The key June Japanese government bond futures contract is expected to focus on the outcome of a 10-year JGB auction on Tuesday and possible hedge selling by underwriters in the JGB market, traders said.
The Ministry of Finance is expected to offer one trillion yen of new 10-year JGBs at 8.30 a.m. (2330 GMT), with a prospective coupon of 2.6 percent.
The auction will be held without scandal-hit Nomura Securities and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank, both of which held large shares in the underwriting syndicate.
Traders said that investor participation in the auction was expected to be limited ahead of Bank of Japan's quarterly survey of corporate sentiment due out on Wednesday.
The survey, known as the tankan, will be released at 8.50 a.m. on Wednesday (2350 GMT Tuesday).
The majority of the market expects the tankan to provide evidence that Japan's economic recovery is again stalling.

But any signs of an improvement in corporate sentiment, such as a major manufacturers' September diffusion index of beyond plus two, would rattle the euroyen market, which has mostly priced in weak tankan results, traders said.
